name: Doctor
description: Independent emergency recovery companion for the RedLeaf suite.

permissions.reason: Materialize the versioned recovery runtime and retain recovery logs.
Configure and health-check the detached Doctor companion.
Launch the detached Doctor runtime when no bundled runtime is available.
Expose the recovery dashboard through the configured Cloudflare Tunnel.
Run unrestricted Claude Code recovery sessions when explicitly requested.
Run unrestricted Codex recovery sessions when explicitly requested.
Mint a fresh short-lived signed identity for each explicitly requested Doctor turn.
